Name: Admin Page: 3
Description: As an IMPRINT administrator, I want a centralized web-dashboard admin page so that I can manage cards, scanners, and monitor platform health from one place.

Name: Secure Login: 2
Description: As a dashboard user, I want secure authentication so that IMPRINT access to RFID and scanner data remains protected.

Name: Wrong Username/Password Messages
Description: As a dashboard user, I want clear and accessible login failure messages so that I can correct credential mistakes quickly without exposing sensitive details.

Description: As an IMPRINT developer, I want each scanner to authenticate with a unique device secret so that only trusted hardware can submit RFID scans.

Description: As an operations manager, I want to export scan logs as CSV so that I can analyze RFID activity outside the dashboard.

Description: As a field technician, I want to provision an IMPRINT scanner from a QR payload so that device setup is repeatable and low-friction.

Description: As a DevOps engineer, I want an automated retention job for IMPRINT logs so that storage stays controlled and policy-compliant.

Description: As a mobile dashboard user, I want the navigation to collapse into a drawer so that IMPRINT pages remain usable on small screens.

Name: Events Graph
Description: As an analyst, I want an events graph in the web dashboard so that I can quickly understand RFID scan trends over time.

Name: Chart with Calendar that shows heat map
Description: As a site manager, I want a calendar heatmap of scan volume so that I can identify unusually high or low RFID activity days.
